tools.name: jobslop_index_overview
tools.description: Current totals for the JobSlop public index: jobs, active, inactive, ghost-flagged listings and companies, when the index was generated, and what it covers. Call this first to see how fresh and how large the data is.

tools.name: jobslop_search_jobs
tools.description: Search tracked US job listings by keyword, company, status, location and posting age. Returns compact summaries with paging; use jobslop_get_job for one listing's full detail.

tools.name: jobslop_get_job
tools.description: Full detail for one listing by its JobSlop id: dates, sightings over the last 30 days, reposts, whether it is flagged as a ghost job and why in plain language, and the job description.

tools.name: jobslop_find_job_by_url
tools.description: Check whether JobSlop tracks the job posting at a given URL and, if so, return its status and ghost-job flag. Use this when someone shares a job link and asks whether it is a ghost job.

tools.name: jobslop_company_report
tools.description: How one employer's tracked listings look: counts of active, inactive and ghost-flagged listings, the share flagged, and its listings (ghost-flagged and longest-open first).

tools.name: jobslop_list_companies
tools.description: Companies in the JobSlop index with their listing counts. Filter by name and sort by size or by how many listings are ghost-flagged.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search tracked US job listings by keywords such as role, company or location. Returns ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full text for one listing id returned by search: status, dates, reposts, ghost-job flag and description.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jobslop_find_job_by_url · Public sink: jobslop_company_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jobslop_find_job_by_url · Public sink: jobslop_company_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
